before.question:
Determine the rate trend shown by the gas-volume graph over0–40 s and40–80 s, using supporting volumes.

before.answer: The graph rises from0 to about37.9 cm³ by40 s and then to about51.9 cm³ by80 s. Smaller gain in the second equal interval supports a declining average rate.
